import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def cohens_d(g1, g2):
    n1, n2 = len(g1), len(g2)
    var1, var2 = g1.var(ddof=1), g2.var(ddof=1)
    pooled = np.sqrt(((n1-1)*var1 + (n2-1)*var2) / (n1+n2-2))
    return abs(g1.mean() - g2.mean()) / pooled if pooled > 0 else 0.0
